newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will ask the government to increase the health budget to 3.2 percent of the GDP, up from a previous 2.8 percent.

* The Romanian army has to spend some $4.0 billion lei until 2005 if the country joins NATO in a first wave of its planned eastward expanion, General Dan Zaharia, the head of army's procurement department told parliament.
* Romanian Defence Minister Victor Babiuc signed military a cooperation accord with his Greek counterpart Akis Tsohatzopoulos.
Tsohatzopoulos said Romania and Greece are key elements of the region's stability and therefore NATO should open to countries like Romania. He said Greece fully supported Romania's bid to join NATO.
* The government inviteed opposition parties to talks on the 1997 draft budget law.
